channel.title: RSS Aggregator Feed
channel.description: An aggregated feed of Technology-related news

item.title: This company wants to stop underwater drones and even submarines with a whole new form of sonar technology
item.description: A sensor that listens silently, then calls in a second one to ping the target, could be a key pairing that helps the US Navy track underwater drones before they reach the pier.

item.title: Trump bought SpaceX shares two weeks after blockbuster IPO
item.description: The president bought when the stock was in the mid-$150 range. SpaceX finished trading on Monday back at its IPO price of $135.

item.title: Bitdefender VPN Review: Fast and Affordable Privacy
item.description: Bitdefender VPN has an excellent starting price, even if it lacks the advanced features that privacy nerds may want.

item.title: Sandisk's huge new SSDs are set up specifically for NAS devices, with the largest offering a frankly ridiculous 7.68TB
item.description: Sandisk introduces NAS-focused SSDs spanning 500GB to 7.68TB, combining SATA and PCIe 5.0 interfaces with high endurance ratings.

item.title: Can You Kill Salmonella in Eggs Without Cooking Them? I Tried It
item.description: With advice from infectious disease experts, I tested a low-effort way to pasteurize eggs at home.

item.title: Zillow and Redfin settle FTC antitrust case
item.description: Zillow and Redfin reached a settlement with the FTC, which requires Redfin to reenter the rental advertising business.

item.title: How to use Samsung's new My FanCam feature to make yourself the main character in your videos
item.description: Zooming in on your kid's performance in the school play is about to get a whole lot easier. It's going to look better, too.

item.title: The Best Kitchen Gadget to Prevent Salmonella Is a Good Meat Probe
item.description: Salmonella outbreaks are seemingly everywhere right now. A good temperature probe is the last and best line of defense.

item.title: Showcase your startup at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 and book an exhibit table while there’s still space
item.description: Make the most of Disrupt's crowds of potential investors and partners by exhibiting your startup from October 13-15.

item.title: Threads is testing a podcast transcription feature
item.description: Meta keeps trying to entice audio content creators to Threads.

item.title: Alabama launches investigation into OpenAI’s hack of Hugging Face
item.description: Weeks after OpenAI disclosed that one of its cybersecurity models had gone rogue and hacked AI dataset company Hugging Face, Alabama’s attorney general announced an investigation into the incident.

item.title: Amazon hikes hardware prices by 60%, blaming memory shortage
item.description: As the memory shortage continues to cause trouble for hardware makers, Amazon says it is now being forced to pass on the costs to its consumers.

item.title: Amjad Masad, CEO and co-founder of Replit, joins the Disrupt Stage at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
item.description: At TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, Replit CEO Amjad Masad will share his perspective on the future of programming and Replit's role in developing it.

item.title: The cat-and-mouse game over 3D-printed guns has begun
item.description: The creator of the world's first 3D-printed gun claims he's developed a way to thwart government-mandated software meant to block 3D printers from making firearms. item.title: Apply now to host a Side Event at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
item.description: Apply before September 4 to be a part of the TechCrunch Disrupt community by hosting your own Side Event.
